source_engines: ZCode (GLM) ingestion of the Gemini P2 research pass (Oct 2-5 window; boards via SportsBettingDime, FOX Sports, SI CFB HQ, Saturday Down South, BetMGM Blog; straw polls: The Athletic, FOX Sports). Every odds entry names its carrier and date. Players with no published fixed-odds line are listed in notes, not guessed.

contenders.stat_line: 823 REC YDS, 9 REC TD through Week 5; 11-206-2 at No. 14 Iowa (ESPN/box scores)
contenders.case_for: Near even money after back-to-back 200-yard games (217-4 vs Illinois, 206-2 at Iowa) — the first Ohio State receiver ever to do it; The Athletic's first straw poll of the season has him as the runaway No. 1.
contenders.case_against: A non-quarterback has won the Heisman twice since 2010; he shares the ballot's Ohio State narrative with QB Julian Sayin, and books are pricing the liability defensively.
contenders.deciding_game: vs Penn State, Nov 8 (and the Michigan game) — a receiver needs statement stages.

contenders.stat_line: 17 TD passes against 21 incompletions through Week 5 (Miami 5-0)
contenders.case_for: The cleanest quarterback board in the country behind an undefeated top-five team; FOX's watch board has him as the clear QB1; On3's No. 1 valuation at $6.5M.
contenders.case_against: Lopsided leads keep suppressing second-half volume — the raw yardage totals retail voters favor; No. 1 NIL valuation cuts both ways with old-school voters.
contenders.deciding_game: vs CJ Carr and Notre Dame, Nov 7.

contenders.stat_line: 16/22, 285 YDS, 3 PASS TD + 1 RUSH TD at No. 16 Mississippi State
contenders.case_for: The week's largest leap (+1700 → +750; briefly +350 in-play Saturday); four total touchdowns in a road blowout of a ranked SEC defense.
contenders.case_against: The market's clear Week 6 catalyst cuts both ways: the Georgia game can mint the favorite or end the candidacy in one afternoon.
contenders.deciding_game: vs No. 2 Georgia, Sat Oct 10 (GameDay site, ABC 7:30 PM ET).

contenders.stat_line: 4 PASS TD at North Carolina (37-26); 15-game Irish winning streak
contenders.case_for: The preseason favorite (+700) keeps winning with four-TD efficiency; FOX's board slots him tied-third with Russell.
contenders.case_against: The independent schedule that made him the preseason pick also limits ranked stages after Oct 10.
contenders.deciding_game: vs No. 21 UCLA / at No. 13 Oregon are gone from the card — Stanford first, then the November gauntlet.

contenders.case_for: FOX's board ranks him No. 5; a perfect SEC finish flips the conversation.
contenders.case_against: The earlier defensive liabilities mean an undefeated finish is required — no margin.

contenders.case_for: The market's Georgia hedge: win in Tuscaloosa and the No. 2 team's quarterback enters the board's top tier by gravity.
contenders.case_against: Georgia's wins have been so lopsided the passing volume never accumulates.

contenders.stat_line: 215.5 passing YPG average; Texas 4-0, No. 1 AP
contenders.case_for: Name brand plus the No. 1 team; Red River on ABC at 3:30 PM ET is the biggest stage of Saturday's early window.
contenders.case_against: The line drifted +2500 → +3200 as Texas leaned run; game-manager volume does not win trophies.

contenders.stat_line: Week 4 Athlete of the Week on this site; three turnovers vs Alabama
contenders.case_for: Preseason +15000 to +480 entering Week 5 is the fastest climb of the season; the raw talent did not leave.
contenders.case_against: The week's steepest crash (+480 → +3000) after three turnovers in the home loss to Alabama; Chris Jones's collective-retention pledge (FOS) keeps the roster intact but not the odds.
contenders.deciding_game: Bye week — the market reopens Oct 17.

contenders.case_for: Top-five passing yardage on a playoff lock; keeps producing while Smith eats the headlines.
contenders.case_against: Ballot-splitting with Smith is structural, not speculative — the same voters see both every week.

contenders.case_for: Undefeated defending-champion quarterback with on3's $4.0M valuation.
contenders.case_against: The market still treats Indiana's sheet as unverified; a loss deflates everything at once.
contenders.deciding_game: at No. 5 Nebraska? No — at 5-0 Nebraska (unranked no more), Sat Oct 10, FOX.

contenders.case_for: The upset of Florida re-priced the whole Missouri roster.

notes: No line published (Oct 2-5 window), carried explicitly rather than dropped: Jayden Maiava (USC QB; +3000 entering Week 5, 11% DK-Predictions implied), Kevin Jennings (SMU QB), Nate Sheppard (Duke RB), Drew Mestemaker (Oklahoma State QB; 13% implied Oct 2), Braden Atkinson (Oregon State QB — the FBS passing-yards leader at 1,851).

Straw polls carried: The Athletic's first 2026 straw poll (Smith runaway) and FOX Sports' watch board (Smith, Mensah, Russell/Carr T3, Chambliss) — both via the P2 report's citations. ESPN's own ballot was not published in the window.
Inter-report discrepancy: P2 cited Atkinson's Week 5 game as 30/33-404; the box-score-audited P5 line (31/34-428) reconciles with the verified season total and is used everywhere on this site.
